name: @pipeworx/mcp-geodistance

tools.name: distance
tools.description: Great-circle (haversine) distance between two lat/lon points. Returns the distance in km, miles, nautical miles, meters & feet, plus the initial compass bearing from point 1 to point 2.

tools.name: destination
tools.description: Given a start lat/lon, a bearing (degrees) and a distance, compute the destination point. `unit` = km (default), mi, nmi, m or ft.

unit.description: Distance unit: km (default), mi, nmi, m, ft.

tools.name: dms_to_decimal
tools.description: Parse a degrees-minutes-seconds coordinate string to decimal degrees. Accepts forms like "40°26′46″N" or "40 26 46 N" or "-73.5". Returns the decimal value.

tools.name: decimal_to_dms
tools.description: Convert decimal lat/lon to degrees-minutes-seconds strings.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geodistance forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geodistance pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
